p1: [low, ominous] In two thousand nine, a serial killer buried a bucket in the Vermont woods. [low, tense] He came back for it... two years later.
[low] Inside: [whispers] weapons... [low, cold] and supplies to get rid of bodies.
[low] His name was Israel Keyes. [low, ominous] The FBI called them... his murder kits.
[low, tense] He hid them around the country, so they'd be ready whenever he came back.
[low] June, twenty eleven. He flew from Alaska to Chicago, rented a car, and drove to Vermont.
[low, cold] He picked a married couple. Total strangers. [whispers] Chosen at random.
[low, ominous] Then he dug up the bucket he had buried two years before... [whispers] and used it.
[low] He was finally caught in Texas in March, twenty twelve, using a stolen debit card.
[low, tense] He admitted to more killings. [low, ominous] The FBI believes there were eleven victims.
[low, cold] Some of them have never been identified.
[low] And investigators say the full truth of what he did... [whispers] may never be known.
